The Commissioner of Police, Gombe State Command, Umar Chuso, has decorated nine senior officers recently promoted in the Nigeria Police Force. The ceremony, held on Monday at the command headquarters in Gombe, was conducted on behalf of the Inspector-General of Police, Olatunji Rilwan Disu, with members of the command’s management team in attendance. According to a statement signed by the command’s Public Relations Officer, Buhari Abdullahi, the promotion saw two Chief Superintendents of Police elevated to Assistant Commissioners of Police, two Superintendents promoted to Chief Superintendents, one Deputy Superintendent elevated to Superintendent, and four Assistant Superintendents promoted to Deputy Superintendents. The officers promoted to Assistant Commissioners of Police are Garga Ibrahim Audu, Officer-in-Charge of Research and Planning at the state headquarters, and Mapindi Yusuf, Divisional Police Officer, Shongom. Also promoted from Superintendent to Chief Superintendent of Police were Abubakar Kabiru, DPO, Tumfure, and Ibrahim Tukur, Second-in-Command of the Violent Crime Response Unit. The commissioner urged the newly promoted officers to justify the confidence reposed in them by maintaining high standards of discipline, integrity and professionalism. I therefore charge you to uphold the highest standards of discipline, integrity, leadership and professionalism in the discharge of your duties,” he added. Speaking on behalf of the promotees, Mapindi expressed appreciation to the Inspector-General of Police and the Gombe Commissioner for finding them worthy of the promotions. “We sincerely appreciate the Inspector-General of Police and the Commissioner of Police for finding us worthy of these elevations. We reaffirm our commitment to professionalism and effective service delivery,” he said. He also acknowledged the contributions of their families, friends, colleagues and well-wishers, saying their support and encouragement had been instrumental to their achievements. The decoration comes amid other promotion exercises in the Nigeria Police Force. On November 11, the Inspector-General of Police decorated 29 senior officers promoted to the ranks of Deputy Inspector-General of Police, Assistant Inspector-General of Police and Commissioner of Police. The IG urged them to demonstrate integrity, accountability and professionalism in their new positions. Chima Azubuike
